lines.1: 「Ugh... What did I even confess for?」
lines.3: 「I told you Tsushima was a good prospect and pushed you toward him... and then this happened.」
lines.5: 「This time, I sincerely regret what I did.」
lines.8: 「It's fine, Ellie. You did it because you were thinking of me.」
lines.9: 「Besides, the uncertainty was eating at me, so confessing really was the right thing to do.」
lines.10: 「I feel a little better now. It was much better than never saying anything.」
lines.11: 「So I'm not angry with you, Ellie.」
lines.17: Yashi greeted me with truly spectacular sarcasm.
lines.19: 「You've become the man of the hour, Tsushima. Nishizaki, get some shots of him.」
lines.22: 「Leo, today's Weekly Dragon has an article about you on the front page.」
lines.23: 「'Leo Tsushima of Class 2-C Declares His Passionate Love for the Princess! Below, we print the entire confession using data supplied by Ms. Oeyama, as recorded word for word by our reporter...'」
lines.24: 「Why does that teacher always have to meddle?!」
lines.26: ...Of course this is the one time she decides to talk to me.
lines.29: (His lines were cringe, but he's not bad-looking.)
lines.30: ...Ah, I could hear the whispers all around me.
lines.31: I felt eyes on me just walking down the hall.
lines.35: Damn it. Every last one of them was staring.
lines.37: Someone had written my name and the Princess's beneath a love umbrella.
lines.40: They were too afraid of the Princess to put it on the blackboard.
lines.41: But that's no excuse to pick on me exclusively!
lines.43: Everyone's eyes snapped toward the Princess.
lines.45: Even the Princess was a little startled.
lines.48: The whole classroom erupted in cheers.
lines.52: Why was she calling us one at a time today of all days?
lines.62: After school, in the student council room.
lines.63: Once again, the Princess and I were there alone.
lines.64: 「Honestly, the whole school is talking about it. What are you going to do about this?」
lines.66: 「Yes. I got so angry I yanked out the power cord.」
lines.71: 「Well, I don't really mind. I do feel more energetic when I'm dating you.」
lines.72: 「Now I just need to learn to switch gears properly: play when I'm with you, work when it's time to work.」
lines.74: 「Which means we should make the most of our time together, Princess.」
